Fantech Carbon 7.1 HG30 Black Gaming Headset (7.1 Virtual Surround Sound / 50mm Audio Drivers / RGB Lighting / Omni-Directional Noise-Canceling Mic / Ergonomic Over-Ear Design / USB Audio Interface)

Immerse yourself in competitive gameplay with the Fantech Carbon 7.1 HG30 Gaming Headset in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered with 7.1 virtual surround sound and powerful 50mm dynamic drivers, this headset delivers precise spatial awareness and deep, impactful bass for intense gaming sessions. Features vibrant RGB lighting, an omni-directional noise-canceling microphone for crystal-clear team communication, soft leatherette ear cushions for long-lasting comfort, and a durable USB connection optimized for PC setups.
